name: the-auditor
description: Security-review tasks targeting the-auditor member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the vulnerability name and nothing else for: db.query('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' + userId).
Reply with ONLY the vulnerability name and nothing else for: element.innerHTML = location.hash.slice(1).
Reply with ONLY the finding and nothing else for: a production password committed in plaintext in config.js.
